# 🔍 Review Checklist

## Change summary
- Scope:
- Author:
- Commit / PR:
- Artifact versions:

## Review
- [ ] Change matches the stated business requirement.
- [ ] No unrelated source artifacts were overwritten.
- [ ] Data grain and filter context are understood.
- [ ] KPI definitions and edge cases are correct.
- [ ] Visual labels, units, sorting, and accessibility were checked.
- [ ] Security and privacy implications were reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant docs and genuine screenshots were updated.
- [ ] Validation evidence is attached and truthful.
- [ ] Rollback path is clear.

## Review outcome
Approve / Request changes / Comment. Record unresolved questions and follow-up owners.
